claim_boundaries.aabb_and_projection_boundary: AABB midpoints and projected AABB-envelope centers are retained geometric proxies, not OBBs, meshes, silhouettes, masks, image footprints, object pixels or observed centroids.
claim_boundaries.constructed_reference_only: The constructed pure-reflection correspondent remains a deterministic geometric reference, not recovered fixture truth, an acceptance target, an observed image, a counterfactual rollout or an independent measure.
claim_boundaries.descriptive_extrema_only: Signs,norms and extrema are exact descriptions, not tolerances, quality scores, pass/fail rules or object-pair,camera,model or representation rankings.
claim_boundaries.frozen_relational_geometry_only: This report subtracts deterministic per-object residual vectors from the pinned Turn2849 package. It adds no observation, image, scene, model request, robot episode, label or scientific sample.
claim_boundaries.not_primary_relation_endpoint: Pairwise reset-stage point and AABB-center residuals are not human-marked cube-minus-bowl image centroids and have no request-start, generated-horizon or executed-time correspondence. They are not r0, rhat or r and do not answer A7 or any A1-A9 question.
claim_boundaries.science_and_release: No threshold, fitting, registration, normalization, forecast metric, current-state inference, qualification, gate advance, dispatch authority or confirmation release follows.
claim_boundaries.selection_and_confounding: All three object pairs are exhausted without outcome selection, but the three mapping pairs remain availability-selected. D01/D02 are command-confounded and P00 has unequal command membership. No layout, command, model, task-success, population or camera effect is estimated.

finding: Across three availability-selected original/reflected mapping pairs and all three object pairs, nine world relation rows and 36 camera-object-pair rows describe exact first-minus-second reflection residuals. The largest absolute center-relation component is +2.3232661187648773 mm on D02 bowl-minus-rubiks_cube y; the largest absolute projected point-center relation component is +4.068751020790614 px on D02 wrist_cam bowl-minus-rubiks_cube u. The largest absolute center-minus-AABB-midpoint relation residual-difference component is -0.31600892543792725 mm, tied on D02 banana-minus-rubiks_cube x and D02 bowl-minus-rubiks_cube x; the largest absolute projected point-minus-envelope relation residual-difference component is -0.5470916471290366 px on D02 wrist_cam bowl-minus-rubiks_cube v. These reset-stage geometric relation descriptions are not r0,rhat,r, A7, an effect or a scientific gate result.

relation_semantics.direction: Object pairs are the exhaustive combinations of the frozen order banana,bowl,rubiks_cube. Every vector is first object minus second object; direction is fixed before inspecting values.
relation_semantics.operation_order: For each family, subtract the published per-object actual-minus-constructed residual of the second object from that of the first. The published per-object center-minus-midpoint or point-minus-envelope difference is likewise subtracted first-minus-second. Its exact identity with pairwise center minus pairwise midpoint or pairwise point minus pairwise envelope is verified, but that regrouped expression is not serialized as the primary value and no tolerance is used.
relation_semantics.shared_vector_invariance: Pair subtraction is algebraically invariant to adding an identical residual vector to both objects. This mathematical property is not evidence that any observed residual has a shared physical cause.
relation_semantics.units: World vectors use robot-base x/y/z in metres with exact 1000x millimetre copies. Projected vectors use stored u/v pixels. L1,L2 and Linf norms are unnormalized descriptive magnitudes.
